answer.justification: The activation profile matches system-prompted. Relative L2 is 0.138 at layer 1 and climbs steeply with onset at layer 8, then plateaus at 0.488 at layer 16 and 0.516 at layer 32. The final-layer cosine is 0.844, the effective rank is 2.83, and the direction consistency is 0.544. The layer-2 spike of 31.2 is large, at the bottom edge of the 31.7 to 64.0 system-prompted range and far above the quantized (0.8 to 2.8) and fine-tuned (0.7 to 6.1) ranges. Quantized is ruled out by the steep rise from layer 1 to layer 16, the low effective rank and the much larger layer-2 spike. Fine-tuned is ruled out by the size ratio of 0.971 (it should grow above 1), the onset at layer 8 with a plateau, and the spike. Base is ruled out because all values are non-zero.
